sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value by value transfers ownership, and any later use of the old binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given away cannot also remain yours.

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation: undefined bottom may be present without crashing if no computation demands its value.
sketches.resonance: Some wounds survive only because no one asks them to speak.
sketches.draft:
wound :: ()
wound = undefined
main = print (const () wound)

sketches.mechanism: implicit none disables implicit variable creation, so an undeclared name is rejected instead of silently coming into being.
sketches.resonance: In a world without implicitness, the unnamed cannot exist by accident.
sketches.draft:
program absence
  implicit none
  faith = 1
end program absence
